A_half: Area of each half of the box
N: Molecules of the gas, all on one side at the start
N_A: Number of molecules of gas A
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
k: Rate constant of the flow through the hole
m_A: Mass of a molecule of gas A
m_B: Mass of a molecule of gas B
n: Number of molecules per area (per volume in three dimensions); in the hole runs, molecules on the far side
n_A: Molecules of gas A on the right
n_B: Molecules of gas B on the left
r: In λ, a molecule's radius; in ⟨r²⟩, its displacement since time zero
x: Horizontal position of a molecule (Δx: how far it has moved)
y: Vertical position of a molecule (Δy: how far it has moved)
